findings.description: Actual temporal/warrant consumption is still disconnected from observed accounting. Both ledgers run Expansion, while the real preparer contributes only diagnostics. In fresh direct and in-memory SQLite probes, bypassing the temporal Evidence.coverage read with the valid literal full_clip preserved successful support and an identical observed ledger. Existing mutation controls target role.Access and cannot detect this bypass.

Exact-history access still discards the resolved target without expanding its required operands. Fresh full role-profile probes accepted missing, null and string-valued predecessor confidence with empty diagnostics and successful support on both isolated adapters. No predecessor field appeared in expected obligations. Original PilotClip access has the same structural omission. This is prerequisite accounting, not deferred history-head selection.

Checked applicability still lacks derivative activation based on frame_indices. In fresh probes on both adapters, a submission with checked empty frame_indices and explicitly null derivative passed the existing temporal preparer but received UNKNOWN/null required field from the new audit. The preserved-root tests use only the attachment-present fixture.

EvidenceArm and InstrumentRun membership checks only evidence.media and omits plan.competing_set.intent. Fresh direct and SQLite probes classified both root kinds as active despite null plans, with only media identity as justification. Consequently unavailable or mismatched intent membership cannot affect classification.

Scoped preparation retains only each root audit's diagnostics. It drops expected, observed and checked_inactive. Fresh probes produced 8 expected, 8 observed and 4 inactive entries for an individual Evidence audit, then zero entries in all three fields after scoped preparation marked E3 ACTIVE. The semantic UNKNOWN prevents completion but does not supply the required auditable receipt.

Computed-output execution still lacks deletion-sensitive acceptance coverage. Tests assert operand rejection and generic support without requiring Evidence.digest or TestPlan.authored output obligations. Independently deleting the entire computed loop in memory left all 83 computed operand/nested controls passing per isolated adapter. Both ledgers lose the same obligation because they share the implementation.
